'''January 2000 Rochester tournament (22 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY on 22 January 2000. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-tradition-1-22-2000d199/ tradition-1-22-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 23 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-tradition-1-22-2000d199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 23
